captions.detailed: This 3D model is a tapered sleeve designed as a personalized accessory for a thermos or tumbler. It features a hollow, conical shape with a larger diameter at the top than at the bottom, creating a snug fit around a matching tapered vessel. The walls are thin and uniform, and the design includes embossed curved text wrapping around the outer surface to display personalized names or phrases.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric sleeve accessory for a tapered thermos in OpenSCAD. The script should allow users to customize the bottom radius, top radius, wall thickness, and height of the sleeve, and feature two lines of customizable curved text wrapped around the outer surface using the write library.
captions.factory: The design is created within a 'thermos' module. It uses a difference() operation to subtract an inner tapered cylinder from an outer tapered cylinder (both created with the cylinder primitive using different r1 and r2 values to achieve the taper). Two lines of curved text are added to the outer surface of the sleeve using the 'writecylinder' helper module from the 'write/Write.scad' library, with customizable text strings, heights, and vertical offsets.
